name: data-analysis
description: Analyze spreadsheets: pandas runs in a sandbox (no network, time and memory limits) and draws charts with matplotlib; data_sql uses DuckDB. Without it LOKI still profiles data and answers SQL with SQLite, without charts.
license: pandas: BSD-3-Clause; matplotlib: PSF-based; DuckDB: MIT; pyarrow: Apache-2.0
install: pip install pandas matplotlib duckdb pyarrow (the Install button does it, about 150 MB)
